area.whereItIs: **Hosur Road (NH-44)** runs south out of Bangalore towards **Hosur** and **Chennai**. **Electronic City** sits on it at the city end, the **KIADB** estates at **Bommasandra** and **Jigani** follow, joined by a link road, and **Attibele** sits further south at the **Tamil Nadu** border, with **Bannerghatta Road** to the west. The stock mixes **pre-engineered buildings**, **RCC units** and **sheds**, with direct access into south Bangalore.
area.whoItSuits: This stretch suits **electronics, pharma and auto suppliers** that need to sit next to the estates, **ancillary storage** for factories already operating here, and **city-facing distribution** into south and south-east Bangalore. Three in four of our listings here are under **20,000 sq ft**, from about **2,000 sq ft** up. Tell us your **size, budget and use**, and we'll shortlist across all of them.
